description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. The ideal candidate will be passionate about delivering high-quality healthcare and fostering a collaborative team culture. As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and maintaining exceptional standards of care. This is a chance to join a facility committed to excellence and continuous improvement, offering a competitive salary for a qualified professional.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team
